name: Dual Contouring 2D
definition: A technique to generate a 2D mesh (vertices and edges) from a scalar field function by constructing a dual contour within a grid cell based on interpolated intersection points and surface normals.
summary: Dual Contouring 2D extracts sharp 2D contours from scalar fields by placing a single vertex per cell via QEF minimization, differing from its sibling through specific dispatch and sequential processing.
